data.text: Waddle! You are a word master! Should we review the rules once more, or continue our journey to the village?

data.speaker: polly
data.text: Look at the bus! I am thinking of traveling, but Manya is planning. He is using the GOING TO structure!

rules.title: The Intent Formula
rules.explainA: Use 'is' for Manya, He, or She.
rules.explainB: Use 'are' for We, They, or You.
rules.teacherNote: PLE Trap: Always check the subject before picking is/am/are!
